The *Indriya Sutta* ("Faculties", Iti 62) is the thirteenth discourse in the third division (the *Tikanipāta*) of the *Itivuttaka*, located at page 53 of the Pali Text Society edition. In this short discourse, noble attainments are expounded in terms of three spiritual faculties (*indriya*).

No secondary literature passages in the dossier discuss this specific discourse directly; all retrieved references merely discuss the term *indriya* in the context of the five spiritual faculties, the *Indriya Saṁyutta*, or unrelated texts.
